# Mirage 1.1.4

本版本重点提升网页与 Live2D 壁纸的显示清晰度和渲染稳定性，强化动态锁屏与屏保的恢复能力，并优化媒体信息、界面响应和发布包体积。

## 重大更新：动态锁屏与屏保稳定性

- 改进动态锁屏和屏保的配置生命周期、扩展注册、资源部署及退出流程，减少重复实例、配置覆盖和系统墙纸服务不必要重启导致的问题。
- 动态锁屏预览改为异步生成；系统设置中的壁纸预览和取消操作更可靠，配置失败时保留原有配置。
- 修复自定义壁纸设置在动态锁屏和屏保流程中丢失的问题，并改进屏保播放、退出和跨进程快照处理。
- 修复系统唤醒后播放规则未恢复的问题；同时改进显示器资源释放和屏保播放状态同步。

## 网页与 Live2D 壁纸

- 修复部分网页壁纸在 macOS 显示缩放下分辨率降低、画面清晰度异常的问题（Issue #64）。
- 改进 Live2D 网格缓冲复用、Retina 分辨率适配和窗口尺寸变化处理，减少模糊、渲染停顿及重复上传几何数据的开销。

## 播放与界面改进

- 改进壁纸库、属性编辑器、创意工坊和预览界面的后台处理与刷新策略，减少快速操作、条件计算和资源加载造成的界面卡顿。
- 修复媒体信息颜色提取失败后的重试，并在媒体状态未变化时复用已有的封面调色板，减少重复计算。
- 改进场景运行时和屏幕捕获的隔离处理，减少不同壁纸、屏保和诊断流程之间的状态相互影响。

## 发布包与诊断工具

- 优化渲染器运行时和 FFmpeg 的打包方式，发布包不再依赖目标机器上的 Homebrew 解码组件，并减少重复运行时文件。
- 新增本地化的场景颜色诊断工具，可生成脱敏报告用于定位特定 GPU、驱动或渲染路径下的颜色异常；诊断结果本身不代表问题已修复。

## 下载

- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac
- `x86_64`：Intel Mac
- 应用与屏保组件要求 macOS 14.2 或更高版本；原生动态锁屏功能要求 macOS 26 或更高版本

当前构建使用临时签名，首次打开时可能需要在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中选择“仍要打开”。

# Mirage 1.1.4

This release improves display clarity and rendering stability for web and Live2D wallpapers, strengthens dynamic lock-screen and screen-saver recovery, and improves media metadata handling, UI responsiveness, and package size.

## Major Update: Dynamic Lock Screen and Screen Saver Stability

- Improved the configuration lifecycle, extension registration, resource deployment, and exit paths for dynamic lock screens and screen savers, reducing issues caused by duplicate instances, configuration replacement, and unnecessary wallpaper-service restarts.
- Dynamic lock-screen previews are now generated asynchronously. System Settings wallpaper previews and cancellation are more reliable, and the previous configuration is preserved when deployment fails.
- Fixed custom wallpaper settings being lost during dynamic lock-screen and screen-saver flows, and improved screen-saver playback, exit handling, and cross-process snapshot processing.
- Fixed playback rules not being restored after system wake, and improved display-resource release and screen-saver playback-state synchronization.

## Web and Live2D Wallpapers

- Fixed reduced resolution and unexpected loss of clarity for some web wallpapers when macOS display scaling is enabled (Issue #64).
- Improved Live2D mesh-buffer reuse, Retina resolution handling, and resize processing to reduce blur, rendering stalls, and repeated geometry uploads.

## Playback and UI Improvements

- Improved background processing and refresh behavior in the wallpaper library, property editor, Workshop, and previews, reducing UI stalls during rapid interactions, condition evaluation, and resource loading.
- Added retries for failed media-artwork color extraction and reused the existing artwork palette when media state is unchanged, reducing repeated work.
- Improved isolation for scene runtime and screen capture, reducing state interference between wallpapers, screen savers, and diagnostic sessions.

## Packaging and Diagnostics

- Optimized renderer-runtime and FFmpeg packaging. Release bundles no longer depend on Homebrew decoder components on the target machine and contain fewer duplicated runtime files.
- Added localized scene-color diagnostics that generate redacted reports for investigating color issues on specific GPUs, drivers, or rendering paths. Diagnostic results do not by themselves indicate that an issue has been fixed.

## Downloads

- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac
- `x86_64` for Intel Mac
- The app and screen-saver component require macOS 14.2 or later; native dynamic lock-screen features require macOS 26 or later

Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.
